_about: polish1 item 167: TEXAS HOLD'EM in the casino (core/poker_rules.gd, core/poker_ai.gd). stakes: the table's blind levels (small / big blind, buy-in from min_bb to max_bb big blinds, chips taken from the wallet and paid back when you stand up). seats: chairs round the table (you + house players). house: the house players (names and looks ours; tight 0..1 folds more, aggression 0..1 bets and raises more, bluff 0..1 bets with nothing now and then, sims = how many run-outs it plays in its head after the flop, think_s = how long it seems to think, look = how the seated house player looks: gender, outfit / hair (npc ids of data/characters.json npc), hair colour, skin tone). Online the host deals (like darts / pool). Placeholders for the director to tune.
_rebuy_house: a house player who busts is replaced by the next one with a fresh buy-in, so the table stays full
